title: Bramley: plague spreaders are the Sumerian overlord faction

tellings.quote: He thinks that basically these uh you know uh plague promulgators >> Mhm. are um representing the same faction that was lording over humanity in the Sumerian epoch

plain: The writer William Bramley, in his book The Gods of Eden, argues that the people who spread plagues are working for the same faction that ruled over humanity in ancient Sumer, the first cities of Mesopotamia. The philosopher Jason Jorjani sums up Bramley's view for Michels. If true, it would mean one hidden group has guided disasters across thousands of years, from Sumer to Europe.
